name: anim_trio_absorbed_loop
subject: a pink goo Doberman monster lying on top of a pink goo crocodile monster on a sticky paint puddle, hugging tightly, with someone absorbed inside their merged goo bodies
desc: Loop: the two monsters keep hugging and crushing each other tightly, squeezing the one trapped inside their merged goo bodies; their bodies squish, bulge and ripple with each squeeze, a faint dark shape pushing inside, thick sticky goo strands stretching between them and dripping. Both keep their eyes narrowed in satisfied, lewd half-closed slits. They stay lying in place. Heavy, sticky, viscous.
